title: Characterizing the Conformational Dynamics of an Intrinsically Disordered Localization Sequence.
authors: Brownd, Matthew; Chaturvedi, Parth; Fakharzadeh, Ashkan; Moradi, Mahmoud
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文用增强采样模拟表征线粒体定位肽（IDP）单残基变异对构象动态和自由能景观的影响，聚焦无序肽构象机制而非PPI，方法上物理模拟强但缺互作维度。
abstract: Mitochondrial localization peptides (MLPs) play a critical role in directing proteins to mitochondria, yet how subtle sequence variations influence their conformational behavior remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the conformational dynamics of a 15-residue MLP derived from the androgen receptor, together with a comprehensive panel of single-residue variants generated by systematic substitution at the second position. Across all variants, the peptide remains intrinsically disordered, exhibiting broad conformational heterogeneity and no stable folded state. Global measures of compactness show that single-residue substitutions induce only modest changes to overall peptide dimensions. In contrast, residue-level analysis reveals that the identity of the second residue subtly reshapes local structural preferences, particularly near the N-terminus. Small or hydrophobic substitutions enhance transient alpha-helical sampling, whereas polar or charged substitutions favor increased disorder and beta- or polyproline-like conformations. Comparison across variants further distinguishes mutations that preserve wild-type-like structural behavior from those that produce more pronounced deviations in the conformational ensemble. Enhanced sampling simulations highlight the complexity and ruggedness of the underlying free-energy landscape and demonstrate the challenges associated with achieving convergence for short intrinsically disordered peptides. Collectively, these results show that even minimal sequence changes can bias the dynamic structural ensemble of mitochondrial localization peptides, suggesting a potential mechanism by which targeting efficiency may be modulated. More broadly, this work underscores the importance of advanced sampling strategies for accurately characterizing intrinsically disordered localization signals and provides a framework for connecting sequence variation to functional targeting behavior.
abstract_zh: 线粒体定位肽（MLPs）在引导蛋白质进入线粒体中发挥关键作用，然而微小的序列变异如何影响其构象行为仍知之甚少。在此，我们研究了源自雄激素受体的15残基MLP的构象动态，以及通过系统替换第二位残基生成的一组全面单残基变体。在所有变体中，肽保持内在无序状态，表现出广泛的构象异质性且无稳定折叠态。整体紧凑性测量显示，单残基替换仅对肽整体尺寸产生适度变化。相比之下，残基水平分析揭示，第二位残基的身份微妙地重塑了局部结构偏好，尤其是在N端附近。小或疏水性替换增强瞬态α-螺旋采样，而极性或带电替换则有利于增加无序性及β-或聚脯氨酸样构象。跨变体比较进一步区分了保持野生型样结构行为的突变与在构象系综中产生更显著偏差的突变。增强采样模拟突显了底层自由能景观的复杂性和崎岖性，并展示了短内在无序肽实现收敛所面临的挑战。总体而言，这些结果表明，即使是最小的序列变化也能偏向线粒体定位肽的动态结构系综，提示了一种靶向效率可能被调节的潜在机制。更广泛地，这项工作强调了先进采样策略在准确表征内在无序定位信号中的重要性，并为连接序列变异与功能靶向行为提供了一个框架。
